mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_memory (user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, confidence, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{confidence}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_user_memory SET memory_value = #{memoryValue}, confidence = #{confidence}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE ai_user_memory SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_user_memory SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, confidence, source, hit_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY confidence DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, confidence, source, hit_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type = #{memoryType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY confidence DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, confidence, source, hit_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_key = #{memoryKey} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
